title: LA Rams Fan Draws Comparison To DJ Khaled And Gets Packed Out [Watch]
htmlContent:
The Los Angeles Rams and the Los Angeles Chargers played at SoFi Stadium for their preseason game on Saturday night. The game ended with the Chargers winning by six in a 7 to 13 game, but the fireworks happened off the field in the stands.

It's a recipe for disaster when you mix alcohol and testosterone, and right on queue, a brawl broke out at SoFi Stadium. A Rams fan can be seen mouthing off to other fans in the stands, and you can hear instigators in the background yelling 'f*** you DJ Khaled," and to 'Get the f*** out of here, DJ Khaled.'

No Khaled Khaled artists and the leader of the 'We The Best Music' movement was not in attendance. However, Khaled is used to dropping hits at least a couple of times a year, and from the looks of the Rams fan's face, the individuals who packed him out got off some series hits.

You have to give the fan credit though he was able to get off a couple of backhands and was serving them early after an object was thrown at his back by the woman in the pinstripe top and started to go to town, in the words of DJ Khaled 'Another one, in this case, another fight ensued between his friends and another fan in the yellow shirt.

The fan packed out was later seen being escorted out of the stadium, and as for DJ Khaled, you can stream his 'Khaled Khaled' album on all streaming platforms.
